text.p: These are the highlights of stories in Skopje newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Multilateral compensation (general debt settlement) will start on Saturday in Macedonia. Intercompany debt is officially estimated at 10 billion German marks.
- The Czech republic extradited to Macedonia Slave Nestorovski the owner of the pyramid savings society Alfa S. Nestorovski is accused of embezzling 10 million German marks.
- Court administration employees continue their strike demanding a 28 percent salary increase. They will be joined by prison employees and state administration on Monday.
- A Skopje municipal delegation was received Monday by Bulgarian President Petar Soyanov who said he supported meetings at any level between Macedonia and Bulgaria.
- The international Helsinki Federation for Human rights in Macedonia expressed concern over the situation of national minorities in Macedonia due to lack of confidence and tolerance.
- The Macedonian parliament has included the bill on the use of national flags in its agenda for its July 2 session.
- Macedonia will participate with 25 companies at the international Euro partnership fair in Greece.

- Some 30 Macedonian towns asked the Ministry of Justice to change back the territorial division of Macedonia to what it was before. The new law divided Macedonia into 124 municipalities from 34. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
